e.title_en: An agentic tool that distills a gradient-boosted model into an interpretable generalised linear model while an actuary signs off each decision: it states in writing that it is an agentic pricing tool with a human in the loop at every key decision, runs feature selection, categorical grouping, boosted-model training, distillation, and linear fitting as five stages, lets the actuary approve, reject, or leave a remark on each proposed variable and reject any fitted term with a wrong sign or unacceptable p-value, outputs a rating factor table where exponentials of coefficients are read as multiplicative relativities against a base level of one, and carries an MIT licence.

e.body:
**Non-Life Pricing Agent**（`fischerdm/nonlife-pricing-agent`）**是一个**把**机器学习模型**蒸馏成**可解释定价模型**的**精算工作流代理****——**逐字自述为**「**Agentic Python tool that supports actuaries in Non-Life insurance pricing model development. It distills a GBM into an interpretable GLM, with a human-in-the-loop at every key decision.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**自打标签的仓库**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 五个环节，**每一步**都有**精算师的**把关点****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字给出**五步**：**① **特征选择**（**逐字**：**an LLM profiles the dataset and proposes which variables to include, with actuarial rationale per variable**；**而**逐字**：**The actuary reviews each one, approves, rejects, or leaves a remark. Remarks loop back to the LLM for a revised proposal.**）**；**② **类别归组**（**逐字**：**high-cardinality variables (e.g. vehicle brand) are clustered into risk-homogeneous groups by the LLM**，**精算师**复核**与**微调）**；**③ **GBM 训练**（**逐字**：**LightGBM** 以**对数费率**为**目标**、**用 **Friedman H 统计量**排序**前 **N 个**特征的**两两交互**）**；**④ **蒸馏**（**逐字**：**排序后的交互清单**交给 **LLM**，**由**其**提出**哪些**交互**在**精算上**站得住**，**精算师**逐项**复核）**；**⑤ **GLM 拟合**（**逐字**：**statsmodels**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**最值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**人机协作**」**从**口号**变成**一串**可记录**的**决定**——**⭐ 每一步**的**人**都**知道**自己**在**批**什么**，**而**每一次**驳回**都**有**理由字段**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 系数复核闸门：**统计合理性**有**一票否决****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**A post-fit coefficient review gate lets the actuary reject any term whose sign is wrong or whose p-value is unacceptable; rejected terms are dropped and the model is automatically refit.**」**，**并**逐字给出**评级因子表**的**读法**（**逐字**：**`exp(coef)` as multiplicative relativities (base level = 1.0), the direct pricing output**）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一点**是**「**AI 进精算**」**的关键**接口**：**⭐ 即**模型**可以**提案**，**但**「**符号**对不对**」**与**「**显著**不显著**」**这类**可由**专业标准**判断的**事项**，**必须**留给**持牌者**否决**；**⭐ 而**「**否决**后**自动**重拟合**」**意味着**流程**不**因为**一次**否决**而**卡住**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 决定写入检查点，**流程**可**续跑****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**All actuary decisions are saved to YAML checkpoints. Re-running the pipeline skips already-approved stages.**」**，**且**配置与**报告**逐字**按**运行**命名空间**放在**顶层 **`runs/<name>/`**（**逐字**：**one per dataset + target configuration**）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一处**对**实务**很**关键**：**⭐ 即**定价**项目**往往**要**跑**几个月**、**换**几版**数据**，**而**「**已批准**的**决定**不**重来**」**既**省**成本**、**又**让**审计**有**据**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 结构化会话日志，**同时**是**审计轨迹**与**面板数据源****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**Every run also writes a structured JSONL session log to `<run>/reports/sessions/` — capturing every LLM proposal, actuary decision, remark, GBM metric, and GLM fit result. This is the data source for the dashboard.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这是**本轮**最值得**抄**的**一处**工程做法**：**⭐ 即**把**「**模型说了什么**」**与**「**人**怎么**回应**」**都**落成**行式记录**，**于是**「**为什么**最终**选了**这些**变量**」**这个**问题**可以**被**逐行**回答**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[easy-glm]] 与 **[[insurance-glm-tools]] 覆盖**GLM 工具链**、**[[ducklm-sql-glm]] 覆盖**在数据库内**拟合 **GLM**、**[[motor-pricing-glm]] 覆盖**车险 **GLM 定价**、**[[haute]] 覆盖**开源定价引擎****——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以 **agent** 串起**特征到**评级因子表**、**并**把**每一步**的**人工把关**与**意见**留成**结构化轨迹**」这一**流程形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **把**把关点**设计成**逐项**，**而**不**是**一次性**签字**；**② **允许**「**留意见**」**而**不**只有**「**通过／**不通过**」**；**③ **对**统计合理性**设**否决权**，**并**自动**重拟合**；**④ **决定**落成**检查点**，**让**流程**可**续跑**；**⑤ **把**人与**模型的**往来**写成**行式日志**，**供**审计**与**面板**共用**；**⑥ **按**运行**命名空间**组织**配置与**报告**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有运行**该工具**（**未安装 **LightGBM／**statsmodels**、**未调用**任何 **LLM**）**，**故**不主张**其**蒸馏效果**、**不主张**其**评级因子**的**统计性质**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **Python** 源码**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**面板**是否**已实现**、**也**未核实**其**会话日志**字段**是否**如自述**齐全**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**LLM** 的**具体模型**与**提示词**设计**（**⭐ 逐字只说**由 **LLM** 提案，**未**指名**供应商**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 该工具**面向 **Non-Life** 定价**，**⚠️ 本词条**不**主张**其**结果**可**直接**用于**任何**费率报备**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该工具**是**建模辅助**，**不是**精算意见**，**也**不是**费率报备材料**。

e.body_en:
This is an agentic workflow that supports actuaries in non-life pricing model development by distilling a boosted model into an interpretable linear model, stating in writing that it keeps a human in the loop at every key decision. **This entry belongs to the round theme of self-tagged repositories.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, five stages each carry an actuary gate.** The description sets out feature selection, in which a model profiles the dataset and proposes which variables to include with an actuarial rationale per variable while the actuary reviews each one and approves, rejects, or leaves a remark that loops back for a revised proposal; categorical grouping, in which high-cardinality variables such as vehicle brand are clustered into risk-homogeneous groups for the actuary to refine; boosted-model training on the approved feature set with interaction ranking; distillation, in which the ranked interaction list goes to the model, which proposes which interactions are actuarially defensible linear terms for term-by-term review; and finally linear fitting. **This turns human-machine collaboration in pricing from a slogan into a string of recordable decisions, because at each step the person knows what they are approving and every rejection carries a reason.**

**Second, the post-fit coefficient gate gives statistical defensibility a veto.** The description states that the actuary can reject any term whose sign is wrong or whose p-value is unacceptable, with rejected terms dropped and the model automatically refitted, and gives the reading of the rating factor table where exponentials of coefficients are multiplicative relativities against a base level of one, described as the direct pricing output. **A model may propose, but questions of correct sign and adequate significance belong to the qualified professional, and refitting automatically means a rejection does not stall the pipeline.**

**Third, decisions are written to checkpoints so the pipeline can be resumed.** The description states that all actuary decisions are saved to checkpoints and that a rerun skips already-approved stages, with configuration and reports organised per run rather than at fixed repository paths. **This matters in practice because pricing projects run for months across several data vintages, and not repeating approved decisions both saves effort and leaves an audit trail.**

**Fourth, the structured session log serves as both audit trail and dashboard source.** Each run writes a structured line-delimited log capturing every model proposal, actuary decision, remark, boosted-model metric, and linear fit result, and the description identifies it as the data source for the dashboard. **Recording both what the model said and how the person responded, line by line, is what makes the question of why these variables were finally chosen answerable row by row.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover linear-model toolchains, in-database fitting, motor pricing, and an open pricing engine, **while this entry supplies the workflow form in which an agent strings feature work through to a rating factor table while keeping every human gate and remark as a structured trace. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: design gates item by item rather than as one signature; allow remarks rather than only pass or fail; give statistical defensibility a veto with automatic refitting; persist decisions as checkpoints so the process resumes; log the human-machine exchange in rows for audit and dashboards alike; and organise configuration and reports per run.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the tool was neither installed nor run**, no boosting or statistical library was installed and no model endpoint was called, **so no claim is made about its distillation quality or the statistical properties of its rating factors**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the Python source. **Third, whether the dashboard exists and whether the session log fields are as complete as described were not verified. Fourth, which underlying model or prompt design is used was not verified**, the description referring only to a model without naming a provider. **Fifth, the tool addresses non-life pricing and this entry makes no claim that its output can be used directly in any rate filing. Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the tool is modelling assistance rather than an actuarial opinion or filing material.**

It distills a GBM into an interpretable GLM, with a human-in-the-loop at every key decision.；五步逐字 Feature selection、Categorical grouping、GBM training、Distillation、GLM fitting；特征选择逐字 an LLM profiles the dataset and proposes which variables to include, with actuarial rationale per variable. The actuary reviews each one, approves, rejects, or leaves a remark. Remarks loop back to the LLM for a revised proposal.；类别归组逐字 high-cardinality variables (e.g. vehicle brand) are clustered into risk-homogeneous groups by the LLM. The actuary reviews and refines.；GBM 逐字 LightGBM trains on the approved feature set (MSE on log-rate target). Friedman H-statistics rank pairwise interactions among the top-N most important features.；蒸馏逐字 the ranked interaction list is sent to the LLM, which proposes which interactions are actuarially defensible GLM terms. The actuary reviews term by term.；GLM 与复核闸门逐字 statsmodels GLM is fitted on the approved terms. A post-fit coefficient review gate lets the actuary reject any term whose sign is wrong or whose p-value is unacceptable; rejected terms are dropped and the model is automatically refit. A rating factors table then shows exp(coef) as multiplicative relativities (base level = 1.0), the direct pricing output.；检查点逐字 All actuary decisions are saved to YAML checkpoints. Re-running the pipeline skips already-approved stages.；日志逐字 Every run also writes a structured JSONL session log to <run>/reports/sessions/ — capturing every LLM proposal, actuary decision, remark, GBM metric, and GLM fit result.
